philosophy: Rams (Braun 1955-1997, Vitsoe) held that good design is 'Weniger, aber besser' -- less, but better: innovative, useful, aesthetic, understandable, unobtrusive, honest, long-lasting, thorough, environmentally friendly, and as little design as possible. His functionalist minimalism uses strict grids, honest materials, muted greys and whites with a single functional accent colour, and tactile dials and switches whose form explains their use. It directly shaped Apple's Jony Ive-era products and today's Teenage Engineering / Nothing industrial aesthetic.
